hypothesis: The only CPU-speed-compatible three-block LayerCake graph has been trained on millions of synthetic teacher tokens but only 221472 tokens from 5084 natural prompt surfaces. V27 and V28 fit that small natural stream without broad natural generalization. A materially larger, diverse, domain-filtered natural instruction and conversation stream can test the measured data-distribution bottleneck without changing the inference graph.

catalog_lock.focused_test_result: 25 passed with natural-instruction and extraction tests
catalog_lock.claim_boundary: The preregistered finite filter is a reproducible bounded segregation policy, not a claim of literal zero latent world knowledge.

execution_policy.cpu_use: teacher-free LayerCake inference quality, throughput, TTFO, RSS, identity, and physical-sparse certification only

candidate_boundary.reason: The six-block graph measured only 0.38395x optimized-transformer CPU throughput while the three-block parent measured 2.8159x.

sampling_correction.reason: The previous balanced 5084-record main stream repeated rare capability rows thousands of times and showed lower loss without generalization. Uniform record sampling preserves diversity; the separate anchor remains capability-balanced.

staged_decision_rule: Build and hash the immutable search catalog.
Fail closed if the catalog audit finds duplicates, corpus answers, forbidden markers, source hash drift, or fewer than 100 rows in every admitted capability.
Run all source-model generation on CUDA only.
Preserve raw source failures and compose passing search rows only with already independent validation evidence for the exact pinned source.
Freeze the composed artifact identity and exact single-candidate GPU training command in a successor amendment before training.
Reject if fresh teacher-free natural generation does not materially exceed v27, if any collapse remains, or if later runtime certification loses the CPU gate.
prohibited_actions: importing corpus assistant messages or reference answers
nearby learning-rate, seed, decoder, or layer-count sweep
